trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُکَ بِاَحَبِّ مَا دُعَیْتَ بِہٖ وَاَرْضٰی مَا رَضِیْتَ بِہٖ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَنْ اَھْلِ بَیْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَیْہِ وَعَلَیْہِمُ السَّلَامُ۔ اَنْ تُصَلِّیَ عَلَیْہِ وَعَلَیْہِمْ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ وَدَاعَ شَھْرِیْ ھٰذَا وَدَاعَ خُرُوْجِیْ مِنَ الدُّنْیَا وَلَا وَدَاعَ اٰخِرِ عِبَادَتِکَ وَوَفِّقْنِیْ فِیْہِ لَیْلَۃَ الْقَدْرِ وَاجْعَلْھَا لِیْ خَیْرًا مِّنْ اَلْفِ شَھْرٍ۔ مَعَ تَضَاعُفِ الْاَجْرِ وَالْاِجَابَۃِ وَالْعَفْوِ عَنِ الذَّنْۢبِ بِرِضَی الرَّبِّ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALOKA BE-A-HABBE MAA DO-A’IY-TA BEHI WA ARZAA MAA RAZEE-TA BEHI A’N MOHAMMADIN WA A’N AHLE-BAIYTE MOHAMMADIN A’LAIY-HE WA A’LAIY-HE-MUS SALAAMO. AN TO-SALLE-YA A’LAIY-HE WA A’LAY-HIM WA LAA TAJ-A’L WA-DAA-A’ SHAHREE HAAZAA WA-DAA’A KHAROO-JEE MENAD DUNYAA WA LAA WA-DAA-A’ AA-KHERE E’BAADATE-KA WA WAFFIQ-NEE FEEHE LAIY-LATAL QADRE WAJ-A’L-HAA LEE KHAIRAM MIN ALFE SHAHRIN. MA-A’ TAZAA-O’FIL AJRE WAL-IJAA-BATE WAL-A’FEW A’NIZ-ZAMBE BE-REZAR RABBE.

trans.en: O Allah, I beg You for the sake of Your favorite channel through which You are invoked and through the medium of the favorite deed of Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and the Ahle Bayt of Muhammad (a.s) that You bless him and them and do not make this farewell of this month as my farewell from this world and do not make this worship act my last worship act in the world and decree the rewards of Shab’e Qadr for me and make it for me better than a thousand months. And accept my supplications and good deeds and forgive my sins with the pleasure of the Lord.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
